side_sea_intake.action: tilted front-side three-quarter salt-worker seawater intake cycle facing screen-right; keep face, chest, pelvis, knees, and feet on the same diagonal in all frames; lower one small wooden dipper bucket toward an off-frame brine source, scoop, lift with both hands, return to ready; bucket stays connected to the hands; never rotate into a pure side profile

side_kiln_work.action: tilted front-side three-quarter salt-kiln tending cycle facing screen-right; keep face, chest, pelvis, knees, and feet on the same diagonal in all frames; lean toward an off-frame boiling pan, stir brine with one short wooden paddle, straighten slightly, return; paddle stays connected to the hands; never rotate into a pure side profile
